title: Learning path of one stage (paths/<stage>.json): units → lessons, with unlock rules

kind.description: learn = new skill (shows the skill's tutor.intro first); practice = more of the same; review = mix of earlier skills; checkpoint = end-of-unit test; quest = a story-driven multi-step activity (skill whose task source is a quest)

skill.description: Single-skill lesson. Exactly one of skill / mix.

levels.description: Crowns: level 1 completes the lesson and unlocks what follows; later entries are optional replays at higher difficulty

passRatio.description: Share of tasks answered correctly (first try or after a hint) to complete the lesson

requires.description: Lessons that must be complete first. Default: the previous lesson in path order.

entry.description: 'open' = the first lesson of this stage is unlocked from the very start. Every stage of the Polish course is open: finishing grades 1–3 is never required to start grade 4.

icon.description: symbolic icon name; the theme maps it to artwork

area.description: Area id from curriculum.json this unit mostly belongs to

testOut.description: Optional jump-ahead test (Duolingo-style): passing it completes every lesson of the unit
